text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Fuji Kiseki—

"—Trainer-san, Trainer-san. Won't you 
dance a fun dance with us?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I could've sworn the plushie inside the 
crane game just spoke to me...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, just kidding! That voice was me. 
Just a little prank.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
See? There are plenty of lovely little 
ponies around here, aren't there?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I really want to find a way to get them 
onto the main stage, though...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
However, in order to do that, we need to 
do our best in the game, don't we... Hmm, 
what should we do?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki smiles and asks a question. My 
answer to her is—
choice_data_list: I'll try to get as many as I can!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "Is that true? I'm so glad! Ah, but—"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
If you don't get even one, there might be 
a penalty game or something. So be 
careful!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
